objective: Maximize prefill and sustained aggregate decode throughput on four RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs without accuracy or behavioral regression.

candidate_selection.primary_score: geometric mean of candidate/baseline ratios over prefill 8K, 64K, 128K and sustained decode 0K C1/C2/C4/C8 plus 128K C1/C2/C4
candidate_selection.notes: Only candidates passing every accuracy, tool-use, context-capacity, and stability gate are eligible. Results within 3% are treated as measurement-equivalent unless repeat measurements establish a stable difference. Pareto-specialized profiles may be retained only when they pass the same gates and materially outperform the balanced production profile.
